```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(DBI)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)
library(knitr)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
# Rostered player-seasons on one team, from 2016 (the first season with
# defensive box-score lines) through the last complete season. A season still
# being played would add seasons without changing the shape of the signal.
complete_through <- last_complete_cfb_season()
game_window <- 2016:complete_through
store <- file.path(root, "_targets")
player_game <- targets::tar_read(player_game, store = store)
usage <- targets::tar_read(player_usage, store = store)
roster <- dbReadTable(con, "roster")
games <- dbReadTable(con, "games")
pos_levels <- setdiff(
  harmonized_position_levels(),
  c("Athlete", "Position not recorded")
)
pos_seasons <- usage |>
  filter(on_roster, team_games > 0, season %in% game_window) |>
  group_by(playerId, season) |>
  filter(n() == 1L) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(position_group %in% pos_levels) |>
  select(playerId, season, team, position_group)
absence <- player_appearance_sequence(player_game, roster, games) |>
  filter(season %in% game_window) |>
  absence_runs(
    streak = formals(absence_runs)$streak,
    min_gap = formals(absence_runs)$min_gap
  ) |>
  inner_join(pos_seasons, by = c("playerId", "season", "team")) |>
  mutate(position_group = factor(position_group, pos_levels))
absence_by_pos <- absence_summary(absence)

p <- absence_by_pos |>
  mutate(
    is_claim = position_group == "Offensive line",
    tip = sprintf(
      "%s: %s of %s seasons can be read",
      position_group,
      pct(readable),
      fmt(seasons)
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = readable,
    y = reorder(as.character(position_group), readable),
    fill = is_claim
  )) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(tooltip = tip, data_id = as.character(position_group)),
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = "#9CA3AF", `TRUE` = "#374151")) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Can every position show an injury-shaped absence?",
    subtitle = "Share of player-seasons with a steady box-score role, so a run of missed games would show",
    x = "Share of seasons that can show an absence",
    y = NULL,
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "absence-readable-by-position", release = release)
card_interactive(p)
```

```{r}
#| label: by-season-figure
# The readable share season by season, so one season does not set the position.
by_season <- absence |>
  group_by(position_group, season) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    readable = mean(observable),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    tip = sprintf(
      "%s, %s: %s of %s seasons can be read",
      position_group,
      season,
      pct(readable),
      fmt(n)
    )
  )
p_season <- ggplot(
  by_season,
  aes(season, readable, colour = position_group, group = position_group)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(tooltip = tip, data_id = paste(position_group, season)),
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = game_window) +
  scale_colour_position(guide = "none") +
  labs(
    title = "Does the readable share hold across the seasons?",
    subtitle = "Seasons that can show an absence, by position group",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Seasons that can be read",
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()
card_interactive(p_season)
```

```{r}
#| label: absence-table
absence_by_pos |>
  transmute(
    `Position group` = as.character(position_group),
    `Player-seasons` = fmt(seasons),
    `Can be read` = pct(readable),
    `Seasons that can be read` = fmt(readable_n),
    `Absence, then returned` = pct(returned),
    `Season-ending absence` = pct(season_ending)
  ) |>
  kable(
    col.names = c(
      "Position group",
      "Player-seasons",
      "Can be read",
      "Seasons that can be read",
      "Absence, then returned",
      "Season-ending absence"
    ),
    align = "lrrrrr",
    caption = paste0(
      "Rostered player-seasons on one team, ",
      min(game_window),
      " to ",
      max(game_window),
      ". The absence shares are among the seasons that can be read; the offensive line shares rest on very few seasons."
    )
  )
```
